name: Force time resync (Windows)
description: Starts the Windows Time service if stopped and runs w32tm /resync /force, reporting offset before and after. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) nothing is changed and the script only reports what it would do.

output: Before/after offset with [DONE]/[SKIP] lines, or [DRY-RUN] lines. Exit 0; 3 if W32Time cannot be started.
